untertitel_admin: Install, start and update Docker apps from the catalog – like Unraid, just without the command line.
untertitel_nutzer: These are the apps an admin has shared with you. You can open every app that has a web interface.
lade_fehl: The apps could not be loaded.
nicht_verfuegbar: The app service is not responding right now. Docker may be off or the control service is still starting.
keine_installiert_admin: No app installed yet. Browse the catalog and install the first one with a click – it then runs as a Docker container on the NAS.
keine_installiert_nutzer: No app has been shared with you yet. Ask an admin.
oeffnen_titel: Open the app's web interface in a new tab
oeffnen_heimnetz: Opens the app directly at {adresse}: the domain only forwards the FAH-NAS interface; you reach app ports on the home network or via VPN.
protokoll_zeilen_erklaerung: How many of the latest log lines are loaded. More lines take longer.
protokoll_leer: The log is empty – the app hasn't output anything yet.
protokoll_fehl: The log could not be loaded.
aktualisieren_laeuft: Pulling new image and restarting the app …
loeschen_erklaerung: The app's containers and images are removed (images only if no other app needs them). What should happen to the app's data?
loeschen_behalten_erklaerung: The folder /data/apps/{name} stays. If you reinstall the app later with the same name, it finds its data again.
loeschen_loeschen_erklaerung: Settings, databases and everything the app has stored will be deleted irreversibly.
loeschen_tippen: Type the app name to confirm
loeschen_tippen_erklaerung: Protection against accidents: the button is enabled only once “{name}” is entered here.
geloescht_frei: “{name}” has been deleted, {groesse} of storage freed.
autostart_erklaerung: The app starts by itself after the NAS restarts. Off = it stays stopped until you start it.
geheimnis_leer_erklaerung: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
suche_erklaerung: Searches name, description and category. The list updates as you type.
kategorie_erklaerung: Shows only templates in this category.
quelle_erklaerung: Built-in = verified FAH-NAS templates. Unraid = taken from the Community Applications feed. Custom = imported by you.
katalog_fehl: The catalog could not be loaded.
katalog_leer: Nothing found. Change the search or the filters.
katalog_leer_unraid: The Unraid catalog is not loaded yet. “Load Unraid catalog” fetches thousands of templates from the Community Applications feed.
unraid_laeuft: Loading and converting the Community Applications feed …
importieren_erklaerung: Add an Unraid template (XML from Community Applications) or a FAH-NAS template (JSON) as a custom catalog template.
importieren_xml_erklaerung: Paste the contents of the template file here.
importieren_url_erklaerung: The NAS loads the template directly from this https address (e.g. the raw link on GitHub).
importieren_adresse_fehler: Please enter a valid address starting with https:// (the NAS does not accept unencrypted http addresses).
importieren_text_fehler: Please paste the contents of the template.
importiert: Template “{name}” has been added to the catalog.
vorlage_entfernen_frage: Remove the custom template “{name}” from the catalog? Installed apps stay untouched.
installieren_fehl: The template could not be loaded.
installieren_laeuft: Pulling image and starting the app …
name: App name
name_erklaerung: Lowercase, 2–31 characters from a–z, 0–9 and -. Becomes the folder name (/data/apps/name) and the container name. Cannot be changed later.
name_fehler: Name: lowercase, 2–31 characters from a-z, 0-9 and -, starts with a letter or digit.
felder_keine: This template has no configurable fields.
feld_port_erklaerung: Port on the NAS where the app is reachable (1–65535). Ports in use are marked red.
feld_port_fehler: Please enter a port number between 1 and 65535.
name_vergeben: The name “{name}” is already taken – please choose another one.
katalog_installiert_titel: An app from this template is already installed
protokoll_dienst_erklaerung: Shows only the log of a single container of the app, or the installation output.
aktualisiert_images: “{name}” has been updated: {n} {n|image|images} renewed, the app has been restarted.
aktualisiert_keine: “{name}” is already up to date – there were no newer images.
pfad_app_erklaerung: Subfolder in /data/apps/{name}/ – created with the app and backed up by the “apps” snapshot schedule.
pfad_freigabe_erklaerung: A folder in an existing share, e.g. so the app can see your media.
pfad_freigaben_fehl: Shares could not be loaded – only the app folder can be selected.
pfad_keine_freigaben: There is no share yet. Create one under “Shares” first.
pfad_fehler: Please enter a folder name without “..”.
riskant_erklaerung: This template requests permissions that let the app affect the NAS. Confirm each item individually if you trust the app.
riskant_offen: Please confirm all risky items before installing.
compose_erklaerung: This is the generated docker-compose file. For reference only – change it via the fields above.
compose_titel: Custom app from a Compose file
compose_name_erklaerung: The app's name in the catalog under “Custom apps”. The template stays saved and can be reinstalled later.
compose_name_fehler: Please enter a name for the app.
compose_datei_erklaerung: Loads a .yml or .yaml file into the text field below.
compose_text_erklaerung: Each service needs a ready-made image (image:). Not supported: build:, env_file:, configs and secrets. Variables like ${PASSWORT} become input fields. FAH-NAS moves folders outside FAH-NAS (e.g. /srv/…) into the app folder; you can switch them to a share in the next step.
compose_text_fehler: This doesn't look like a Compose file (“services:” is missing).
compose_zu_gross: The file is too large (max. 200 KB).
zip_kurz: Upload your own release ZIP with manage.sh – FAH-NAS lets it set itself up.
zip_erklaerung: Choose an app ZIP: with manage.sh (e.g. unifi-extraktor.zip), FAH-NAS runs “manage.sh update”; without manage.sh, a Compose file or Dockerfile is enough – FAH-NAS then builds and starts the app itself.
zip_update_erklaerung: The new ZIP runs through “manage.sh update” as usual. The app's data and settings are kept.
zip_datei_erklaerung: Ideally with the original name – manage.sh looks for its ZIP by that name.
zip_keine_datei: Please choose a ZIP file first.
zip_zu_gross_proxy: The file is too large for the proxy in front of the NAS. Upload it on the home network directly via the NAS address.
zip_name_erklaerung: Folder and name of the app under Apps. Lowercase, 2–31 characters from a–z, 0–9 and -.
zip_schon_installiert: This app is already installed as “{name}”. For an update, use “Apply new ZIP” there.
zip_laeuft: manage.sh update is running – building can take a few minutes.
zip_aktualisiert: “{name}” has been updated with the new ZIP.
bearbeiten_erklaerung: Ports, folders and variables of this app. Changes apply at the next start.
bearbeiten_erklaerung_laeuft: Ports, folders and variables of this app. The app is running – “Save” applies at the next start, “Save and restart” immediately.
bearbeiten_konflikt_hinweis: {text}. Enter a free NAS port below and start the app.
bearbeiten_angepasst_hinweis: This app has been customized. “Reset to original” restores the settings from the template or ZIP.
bearbeiten_ports_erklaerung: NAS port = address on the home network (http://NAS:Port), container port = port inside the app. In case of a conflict, only change the NAS port.
bearbeiten_pfade_erklaerung: NAS folder inside the app folder (e.g. daten/…) or in a share (e.g. private/… or /data/shares/private/…); container folder = path inside the app.
bearbeiten_variablen_erklaerung: App settings, e.g. TZ = Europe/Berlin. Hidden values (passwords) stay unchanged if you leave them empty.
bearbeiten_host_netz: This service uses the NAS network directly – its ports apply without redirection.
bearbeiten_zuruecksetzen_frage: Discard all customizations of “{name}” and use the original settings?
bearbeiten_gespeichert: “{name}” saved – applies at the next start.
angepasst_titel: Ports, folders or variables were changed under “Edit”
zip_ohne_skript: none – FAH-NAS builds and starts it itself (Compose/Dockerfile)
ordner_erklaerung: Choose a folder in the app folder or in a share and click “Use this folder”.
bearbeiten_gpu_erklaerung: Gives the app the NAS graphics card, e.g. for fast video conversion or AI. Applies from the next start of the app.
bearbeiten_gpu_nvidia_fehlt: An NVIDIA card is installed but not set up yet – you can do that under System → Graphics card.
sichtbar_erklaerung: Admins always see all apps. Selected users see the app in their list and on the overview and can open it.
sichtbar_grenze: On the home network the app stays reachable via NAS address and port – only its own login protects it there.
sichtbar_keine_nutzer: There are no users without admin rights and no groups yet.
ue_kurz: Take over Docker apps of the old NAS (UGOS, Synology): compose projects from the old Docker store, volumes are copied – the old store stays unchanged.
ue_titel: Take over Docker from the old NAS
ue_sicher: Safe: the old Docker store is only read, never started or changed. Compose files stay in their old place (via the old path /volumeN), Docker pulls images again from the internet, volumes are copied.
ue_keine_ablage: No old Docker store found. First take over the volume holding @docker under Drives → “Take over storage from another NAS” and switch on the old path there.
ue_lief_titel: At least one container of this project was running under the old system.
ue_pfad_fehlt_text: First switch on the old path {liste} (Drives → Take over storage → old path). The compose file addresses folders through it.
ue_name_erklaerung: Name of the app in FAH-NAS (lower case, 2–31 characters a-z, 0-9 and -). The compose project keeps its name.
ue_autostart_erklaerung: Starts the app with the NAS. Suggested as under the old system (restart policy “always”/“unless-stopped”).
ue_volumes_erklaerung: Volumes – checked = copy data. Unchecked, the app starts with an empty volume (only sensible for caches).
ue_keine_projekte: This store has no compose projects.
ue_einzeln: Without compose file (docker run) – cannot be taken over, please recreate by hand: {liste}
ue_laeuft: Copying volumes, pulling images and starting apps
ue_name_ungueltig: App name for “{projekt}” invalid (lower case, 2–31 characters a-z, 0-9 and -).
ue_name_belegt: App name for “{projekt}” is already taken.
ue_ok_start_fehler: {name} taken over, but does not start: {fehler}
ue_fertig_tipp: The apps are now listed under Apps. A project that does not start can be adjusted via “Log” and “Edit”; the old store stays unchanged as a way back.
ue_badge_titel: Taken over from the old NAS ({quelle}) – compose files in {ordner}
ue_loeschen_hinweis: Taken-over app: compose files and folders in {ordner} and the old Docker store stay untouched in any case. “Delete data” only removes the Docker volumes copied to FAH-NAS.
ue_platz_system: Docker lives on the system disk ({pfad}) with {frei} free. For large volumes first move Docker to a bigger volume under Drives → Storage locations.
ue_platz_volume: Docker lives on a taken-over volume ({pfad}) with {frei} free.
ue_platz_zu_wenig: Not enough space: the selected volumes need {noetig}, the Docker store has {frei} free. Move Docker under Drives → Storage locations first or deselect large volumes.
fg_kurz: Build a FAH-Git project directly as an app – using its docker-compose.yml or Dockerfile; update later with one click (or automatically).
fg_erklaerung: Pick project and branch. FAH-NAS fetches the latest state via the connection set up under System → Basics, checks it like a ZIP and builds it with the project's manage.sh. Without a manage.sh it uses docker compose or the Dockerfile.
fg_zur_verbindung: Go to the FAH-Git connection (System → Basics)
fg_keine_projekte: No projects are visible in FAH-Git for this access key.
fg_projekt_erklaerung: All projects the stored key may see in FAH-Git – with folder path.
fg_projekt_leer: The project has no commit yet – push something first.
fg_projekt_unbekannt: The project “{pfad}” is not (or no longer) visible in FAH-Git.
fg_zweig_erklaerung: The latest commit of this branch is built; usually the default branch (main).
fg_zweig_wechsel_erklaerung: After switching, “Update from FAH-Git” builds the latest commit of the new branch.
fg_bauweise_dockerfile: Dockerfile (FAH-NAS creates a simple compose file)
fg_schon_gebaut: This project already runs as app “{name}” – “Install new state” rebuilds it (data and .env stay).
fg_auto_erklaerung: FAH-NAS asks FAH-Git every 5 minutes; if the branch has a new commit, the app is rebuilt and restarted. Off: only on demand.
fg_laeuft: Building and starting the project (may take a few minutes) …
fg_aktualisiert: “{name}” now runs the new state from FAH-Git.
fg_schon_aktuell: “{name}” is already up to date with FAH-Git.
fg_aktualisieren_titel: Fetch the latest commit of the branch, rebuild and start
